name: Scribes
overview: Scripture reveals scribes as learned men often esteemed for their wisdom and roles in religious and civil administration, such as secretaries to kings and prophets and keepers of muster-rolls, as seen in 2 Samuel and 2 Kings. They were skilled in handling the pen and interpreting the law, with some families of scribes linked to the Kenites, a detail underscored in 1 Chronicles. Despite their respected status, scribes are also portrayed as opponents of Christ, involved in procuring His death and criticized by Him for hypocrisy and their manner of teaching, highlighting a contrast between their approach and Christ's gospel ministry.
